claude.rationale: The slice documents that acquired assets were integrated and retained over time: the Carbo terminal deferred obligation was still being serviced and the Coen Energy contingent consideration simply ended in 2020, with a continuing acquisition-and-integration function overseeing Kildair and Coen — no product/process incoherence is documented (p4=0). The registrant remained a going concern operating its Northeast/Quebec terminal network with ~654 employees and no documented operations-vs-organization fracture, culture clash, or management/labor breakdown (five collective bargaining agreements noted without conflict), so p5=0. The FY2021 swing to operating/net loss is a financial outcome, not evidence of any documented interface disruption. Nothing in the slice speaks to a controlling-intent archetype (t1=0) or business-model incompatibility (t2=0).
